assessment_rules: For continuous assessment, the project accounts for 50% and two tests for 50%. A minimum score of 8 out of 20 is required for the project and for the average of the two tests. The tests can be retaken in the normal exam period. An oral exam will be given if the average of the Prolog exercises in the second test is less than 8, replacing the project grade. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 9.5 for approval.
